title: Daniel Boone Hotel (Charleston, West Virginia)
geometryBasis: The mapped outline at the National Register address and exact original public-domain Qualla photograph establish the building and exterior proportions.
sectionBasis: The historic record describes a ten-story blond brick mass, with an ornamented two-story mezzanine base, brick shaft with regularly spaced sash windows and a parapet with terra-cotta balustrade. The early-1980s conversion enclosed the back of the U-shaped plan.
limitations: Source measurements of vertical section and rear wall details were unavailable. Heights, roof enclosure and fine terra-cotta profiles are estimated.
The exterior only, with no commercial sign faces, atrium furnishings or unrelated neighboring buildings.
